answer_1.quote: Generating text from structured data has a variety of applications in natural language processing. Tasks such as decoding from tables , question answering from knowledge bases , and generation from RDF Triples , knowledge graphs  and linguistic meaning representations  face similar challenges: interpreting structured input and writing fluent output.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text in 21 languages from AMR graphs

answer_2.quote: We evaluate with detokenized BLEU using sacrebleu.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation by asking native speakers to evaluate word order, morphology, semantic faithfulness (with respect to the reference) and paraphrasing (how much the generation differs from the reference) on a 3 point scale.
answer_4.guideline: evaluators assessed word order, morphology, semantic faithfulness, and paraphrasing on a 3-point scale
